title: Stroma-Dominant Colorectal Cancer Harbors CAF-Rich Spatial Architecture and EMT-Associated Cancer Cell Plasticity Detectable After Dissemination.
snippet: Colorectal cancers (CRCs) include stroma-dominant tumors with desmoplasia and differentiated, gland-forming tumors with little stroma. We asked whether this difference reflects stromal abundance alone or also involves a distinct cancer cell state.
